description: Write compelling, conversion-focused copy for any medium. Trigger when: writing marketing copy, landing page text, email campaigns, ad copy, product descriptions, social media posts, headlines, taglines, or sales pages; improving existing copy for clarity, persuasiveness, or brand voice; increasing conversion rates; developing or auditing brand voice; or any persuasive writing task. Before writing, clarify: audience (who, fears, wants), goal (click, purchase, sign up, share), channel (email, landing page, ad, social), tone (formal, casual, urgent, inspirational), and the one key message. Key capabilities: AIDA, PAS, and Before/After/Bridge frameworks; brand voice capture system (3 words the brand IS, 3 words it is NOT, who speaks, what they never say); headline writing rules (benefit-led, numbers, questions, urgency without fake scarcity); email copy structure (subject → preview → opening → body → single CTA); copy audit checklist (5-second benefit test, one-person test, single CTA check, "so what?" on every claim). Ideal for: marketers, founders, and content creators who need persuasive text that actually converts. Also for: brand voice development and documentation; editing existing copy for clarity and punch.
